stories.title: Norris Wins Brazilian GP, Mercedes Seal 2026 Constructors' Championship

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Lando Norris wins the Brazilian Grand Prix for McLaren.

Mercedes seal the 2026 F1 Constructors' Championship. Russell 4th. Antonelli 5th.

Verstappen went from 21st on the grid to 2nd. That race had everything.

#F1 #BrazilianGP

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Kimi Antonelli was leading the Brazilian GP until a Lap 20 spin at Turn 1.

Lando Norris took the lead and never looked back. Race winner.

Mercedes still clinched the constructors' title. Wild afternoon in São Paulo.

#F1 #BrazilianGP

stories.title: Verstappen's Stunning Charge from 21st to 2nd at Interlagos

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Max Verstappen started the Brazilian GP from 21st.

He finished 2nd.

No, we're not exaggerating. That was his actual drive at Interlagos on Sunday.

#F1 #BrazilianGP

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
21st to 2nd in Brazil. Wet conditions. Changing track. A depleted grid in front of him.

Max Verstappen picked them off one by one. That's what elite racecraft looks like.

He can't win the title this year. But he still showed why he's one of the best ever.

#F1

article.headline: Verstappen's Remarkable Charge from 21st to 2nd Is Drive of the Brazilian GP

stories.title: Antonelli Leads Drivers' Championship by 111 Points with Three Races Remaining

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
After Brazil, Kimi Antonelli leads the F1 drivers' championship by 111 points.

Three races remain. Max available per race: 25 points.

This championship is effectively decided. The rookie from Bologna is your 2026 F1 champion.

#F1

stories.title: Leclerc Demoted After Brazil Penalty as Ferrari Launches Investigation

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Charles Leclerc finished 7th in Brazil. Then got a 5-second penalty for pushing Liam Lawson wide.

Final result: 8th.

Meanwhile, Ferrari has launched an investigation into the SF-26 after Lewis Hamilton called the season-end performance "devastating."

#F1
